children: shares were up about 9% in morning trading on Thursday, as renewed interest in AI infrastructure helped lift the server maker alongside a broader technology-market advance.
The move came as investors weighed new forecasts for AI server demand, according to a Thursday market report.

Super Micro Computer was also supported by a Goldman Sachs projection that the global AI server market could reach $1.3 trillion by 2030. That outlook has added attention to companies supplying hardware for expanding data-center workloads.

Another factor was a report that Apple is considering a return to enterprise servers with systems built around its planned M8 Ultra chips. Reuters reported that the project could target AI inference and may use Nvidia networking technology, although the plans could still change.
Broader market strength also provided support, with the Nasdaq gaining more than 1% during the session.

title: Super Micro Computer Stock Soars -- $1.3 Trillion AI Server Boom Lifts Shares
